event_name: Time 15:45 2019 CHINESE GRAND PRIX 11 - 14 April 2019 The Stewards have received a request from Alfa Romeo Racing to allow car 99 to start the race despite failing to set a qualifying time in Q1. In accordance with Article 35.1 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations, the Stewards grant permission for car 99, Antonio Giovinazzi, to start the race, as the driver has set satisfactory times in practice at this Event. The car will be placed on the grid in accordance with Article 35.1 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations.
